image_description: A black and white photograph featuring a person in the foreground holding a bubble wand, blowing large soap bubbles. The most prominent feature is a large, elongated soap bubble in the upper left, which retains vivid iridescent colors (cyan, magenta, yellow) despite the monochrome background. A smaller, similarly colored bubble floats to the right. The background shows blurred figures and urban elements.
